_note: Phantasie I, C64 v1.4 (p1-c64, s216): ids the C64 prints in its own wording, for an import whose I tables are the C64's. Zeus's speech (P.END's DATA, 7 lines in its own breaks: 'ADVENTU-' / 'RE.', no Phantasie II): PETSCII of the lower / upper-case set, read through the importer's P.END:petscii key (0xC1..0xDA capitals, 0x41..0x5A small letters). Parts as in en.sources.json: [file, offset, length] into the raw P.END (load address included). build_string_sources.py adds them as alternatives marked "wording": "own".
_note_only: s224: "only" = lines no other version prints (the C64's own screens: "Zeus  smiles and says", the text page after the grant, its key prompt); build_string_sources.py adds them as plain p1-c64 alternatives (en.p1-c64.json), so they show whichever version's tables are in use; their en.json value is the C64's text.
